description: This file defines a React component 'IngestionClient' for uploading documents related to a career persona builder. It includes UI elements for uploading various document types, managing uploaded files, and orchestrating backend requests to generate a persona draft from uploaded documents. The file interacts with backend APIs for build creation, document upload, and orchestration execution, and manages local storage for persona drafts and IDs.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a number of bytes into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label representing the file extension or 'FILE' if none.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides the UI title for each upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color code associated with an upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file types for uploads.
